content.title: From Starbucks to Smithsonians: What's open and closed on Christmas around DC
content.text: by Jessica JamesMon, December 22, 2025 at 1:17 PMUpdated Thu, December 25, 2025 at 4:04 AMWith the U.S. Capitol in the background, The National Christmas Tree is lit on the West Front of the Capitol, Thursday, Dec. 11, 2025, in Washington. (AP Photo/Rahmat Gul)WASHINGTON (7News) — As the District settles into the holiday spirit, residents and visitors will find varying operating hours this Christmas, with many federal landmarks and major retailers closing their doors while iconic estates and essential services remain open. Government Buildings & MuseumsOpenMount Vernon: George Washington's estate is open and offers a special experience on Christmas DayNational Mall Monuments: The Lincoln Memorial, Washington Monument and WWII Memorial are all openArlington Cemetery: Grounds are open for walkingClosedFairfax County Police offering unique pre-academy training for police officer hopefulsU.S. Capitol: The Capitol, including the Capitol Visitor Center, is closed on Christmas DayLibrary of Congress: Closed on ChristmasSmithsonian's: All museums and the National Zoo are closed on Christmas DayRestaurantsOpenStarbucks: Store hours vary by location.
